spells.name: Bramble
spells.description:
Infects the target and inflicts Earth damage.

On a Leafy Tree: applies the effects on enemies in a 2-cell circle.

On an enemy: also applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

spells.name: Insolent Bramble
spells.description:
Reduces the duration of effects on the target and inflicts Earth damage on enemies.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

spells.name: Sadida's Tear
spells.description:
Heals allies or inflicts Water damage on enemies.

On a Tree: applies the effects in a 2-cell circle and transforms the Tree into a Leafy Tree.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

spells.name: Rise of Sap
spells.description:
Steals HP in the Water element from enemies and heals allies (except the caster) based on the damage inflicted in an area of effect.

On Trees: also transforms them into Leafy Trees.

spells.name: Burning Bush
spells.description:
Inflicts Fire damage and reduces MP.

On a Leafy Tree: applies the effects on enemies in a 2-cell circle.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

spells.name: Bush Fire
spells.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on and removes MP from enemies, and applies the Bush Fire state on Trees and enemies in an area of effect:
• At the end of the target's turn, inflicts Fire damage on enemies in an area of effect around the target.
• Can inflict damage on Trees.

spells.name: Hemlock
spells.description:
Inflicts Air damage.

On a Leafy Tree: applies the effects and maintains the Infection on enemies in a 2-cell circle.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies and maintains the Infection on the target.

spells.name: Poisoned Wind
spells.description: Infects the target and applies a start-of-turn Air poison.

spells.name: Tree
spells.description:
Plants a Tree.
A Tree becomes Leafy after 1 turn.

There can only be 6 Trees per team. Planting a seventh Tree will cause the first one to die.

spells.name: Leafy Tree
spells.description:
Plants a Leafy Tree.
All Trees summoned by the caster immediately turn into Leafy Trees.

There can only be 6 Trees per team. Planting a seventh Tree will cause the first one to die.

spells.name: Madoll
spells.description:
Replaces a Tree with a biddable Doll that can Infect and apply a start-of-turn Air poison.

Upon its death, the Doll becomes a Tree again.
If it was summoned from a Leafy Tree, the Tree it turns into upon dying will again be Leafy.

spells.name: Transmuted Madoll
spells.description:
Summons a biddable Doll that can Infect and apply a start-of-turn Air poison.

The Doll is replaced by a Tree 3 turns after being summoned.

spells.name: Paralysing Sap
spells.description: Infects the target, removes MP Parry from it and applies an end-of-turn Fire poison on it.

spells.name: Miasmas
spells.description:
Infects and applies an end-of-turn Air poison on enemies in an area of effect.
The area of effect extends around Leafy Trees and Dolls.

spells.name: Contagion
spells.description:
Inflicts Air damage and removes MP. 

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies and spreads the Infection in an area of effect around the target.

spells.name: Mangrove
spells.description:
Heals allies and inflicts Water damage on and removes MP from enemies in an area of effect.
The area of effect extends around Trees, and the effects are applied only once per casting.

Also transforms all Trees into Leafy Trees.

spells.name: Soothing Bramble
spells.description:
Heals allies or removes MP from enemies.

On a Leafy Tree: applies the effects in a 2-cell circle.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

spells.name: Repotting
spells.description: Heals a Sadida summons, teleports it to the first available cell between it and the caster, and plants a Tree on the targeted cell.

spells.name: The Block
spells.description:
Replaces a Tree with a biddable Doll that can switch places if bidden and can block enemies.
It can also increase its MP and make itself Unlockable.

Upon its death, the Doll becomes a Tree again.
If it was summoned from a Leafy Tree, the Tree it turns into upon dying will again be Leafy.

spells.name: Transmuted Block
spells.description:
Summons a biddable Doll that can switch places if bidden and can block enemies.
It can also increase its MP and make itself Unlockable.

The Doll is replaced by a Tree 3 turns after being summoned.

spells.name: Aggressive Bramble
spells.description:
Steals MP and inflicts Earth damage.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

spells.name: Charred Charms
spells.description:
Inflicts Fire damage and applies the Charred Charms state on the targeted enemy:
• Part of the damage suffered by the caster's Trees is reflected back onto the target.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

spells.name: Bane
spells.description:
Steals HP in the Water element.

On a Doll: applies the effects on enemies in a 1-cell square.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

spells.name: Haunted Forest
spells.description:
Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and applies the Haunted Forest state on them in an area of effect:
• Infects the target if it attacks one of the caster's Trees.

The area of effect extends in a 1-cell square around Leafy Trees, and the effects are only applied once each time it is cast.

spells.name: Sylvan Power
spells.description:
Replaces a Leafy Tree with a controllable Leafy Tree that can:
• Infect and push a target.
• Heal allies and reduce healing received by enemies in an area of effect.
• Shorten the length of effects on a target.

The controllable Tree is replaced by a Leafy Tree 2 turns after being summoned.

spells.name: Vegetal Influence
spells.description:
Replaces a Leafy Tree with a controllable Leafy Tree that can:
• Infect and attract a target.
• Apply a shield around allies and remove MP from enemies in an area of effect.
• Plant Unmovable Brambles.

The controllable Tree is replaced by a Leafy Tree 2 turns after being summoned.

spells.name: Sacrificial Doll
spells.description:
Replaces a Tree with a biddable Doll that can sacrifice itself to Infect and inflict Water damage in an area of effect.
Its Vitality and final damage increase with each turn.

Upon its death, the Doll becomes a Tree again.
If it was summoned from a Leafy Tree, the Tree it turns into upon dying will again be Leafy.

spells.name: Transmuted Sacrificial Doll
spells.description:
Summons a biddable Doll that can sacrifice itself to Infect and inflict Water damage in an area of effect.
Its Vitality and final damage increase with each turn.

The Doll is replaced by a Tree 3 turns after being summoned.

spells.name: Wild Grass
spells.description: Inflicts Fire damage and removes MP from enemies in an area of effect.

spells.name: Voodoo Curse
spells.description:
Inflicts Water damage and applies the Voodoo state on the targeted enemy:
• Inflicts Water damage on the target when one of the caster's Dolls dies.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

spells.name: Voodoo Sacrifice
spells.description:
Inflicts Water damage.
The damage is greater on summons.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

On a Doll:
• Sacrifices the Doll to heal allies, apply the effects on enemies and Infect them in an area of effect.
• Resets its cooldown period.

spells.name: Ardent Thistles
spells.description:
Inflicts the Ardent Thistles state on the targeted enemy:
• Applies an end-of-turn Fire poison on the target for each MP it uses (stackable 3 times).

On an enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

spells.name: Tree of Life
spells.description:
Plants a Tree of Life.
The Tree of Life turns back into a Leafy Tree 2 turns after being summoned.

spells.name: Vegetal Altruism
spells.description: Sacrifices a Leafy Tree or a Doll to increase Dolls' Vitality and heal the caster.

spells.name: Inflatable Doll
spells.description:
Replaces a Tree with a biddable Doll that can heal, inflict Fire damage and repel.

Upon its death, the Doll becomes a Tree again.
If it was summoned from a Leafy Tree, the Tree it turns into upon dying will again be Leafy.

spells.name: Transmuted Inflatable
spells.description:
Summons a biddable Doll that can heal, inflict Fire damage and repel.

The Doll is replaced by a Tree 3 turns after being summoned.

spells.name: Earthquake
spells.description:
In an area of effect around the caster, a Leafy Tree or a Doll:
• Inflicts Earth damage on enemies.
• Attracts entities towards the centre of the area of effect.
• Reveals invisible entities.

spells.name: Mandrake
spells.description:
Inflicts Air damage and applies the Mandrake state on the targeted enemy:
• Infects the target if it suffers damage from a poison or summons.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

spells.name: Inoculation
spells.description:
Increases the spell's damage for each Infected enemy and inflicts Air damage.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

Consumes all Infections around the target.

spells.name: Force of Nature
spells.description:
Inflicts Earth damage.
Spell damage is increased for each of the caster's Leafy Trees that has been planted.

On an Infected enemy: applies the effects on all Infected enemies.

spells.name: Natural Gift
spells.description:
Sacrifices a Leafy Tree or a Doll to share the damage among allies and heal them in an area of effect.
Damage sharing does not affect static summons.

spells.name: Harmony
spells.description: Roots the caster and shares damage between all their Trees and the caster.

spells.name: The Ultra-Powerful
spells.description:
Replaces a Tree with a biddable Doll that can inflict Earth damage, remove MP or give MP.
It can also summon another biddable Doll that can steal or give Range.

Upon its death, the Doll becomes a Tree again.
If it was summoned from a Leafy Tree, the Tree it turns into upon dying will again be Leafy.

spells.name: Transmuted Ultra-Powerful
spells.description:
Summons a biddable Doll that can inflict Earth damage, remove MP or give MP.
It can also summon another biddable Doll that can steal or give Range.

The Doll is replaced by a Tree 3 turns after being summoned.
